text:
Ava: follow-up from RFC: proposal to decouple orchestration surface into a thin coordinator + stateful workers. goal = smaller hotpath and clearer ownership for retries/visibility.

Diego: high level sounds good. main tradeoff: more RPCs between coordinator and workers -> latency and retry complexity.

Ava: agreed. thinking: coordinator keeps opaque request id + routing decision, workers own execution and backoff. coordinator only blocks on immediate placement, not on long-running execution.

Mei: question: current session-store + batcher are tightly coupled. do we split session-store into a per-worker shard or keep a shared cache?

Diego: prefer per-worker shard for locality, but need a light gossip/consistency protocol for slot reclamation. otherwise risk duplicate executions.

Ava: design sketch: coordinator->worker RPC has 3 phases: 1) allocate slot (fast) 2) handoff payload (stream) 3) ack commit. if worker crashes, coordinator reassigns after lease expiry.

Mei: lease expiry semantics need careful SLOs. propose default lease = 30s with jitter; retry window configurable per tenant.

Diego: failure scenarios: partial commit during handoff -> use idempotent ops with monotonic sequence numbers. we already have a monotonic request-id in router; reuse that.

core-bot: NOTE: dependency check -> this change touches runtime-proto v2, session-store, batcher, and deploy-router.

Ava: migration path idea: run worker code in shadow mode behind feature flag. coordinator will shadow-dispatch to new workers and compare outcomes for 48h.

Mei: plus add a replay test that replays 1% of live traffic into worker-only path and assert deterministic outputs (hash-based).

Diego: data migration: session-store shards created with lazy ownership. initial mapping: hash(session_id) -> worker shard. we'll need a move API for rebalancing.

Ava: rebalancing plan: start with small shard count (64) to avoid noisy moves, then expand. move API must be rate-limited and observable.

Mei: observability checklist: per-worker health, commit latency histogram, handoff failure counters, duplicate-execution alerts. tag all traces with coord_id and worker_id.

Diego: perf targets: coordinator extra RPC should add <3ms p95 to median path for colocated deployments. for cross-az, plan to bias placement to same az.

Ava: security note: worker needs least-privilege to access model artifacts and keys via short-lived creds. integrate with kms-proxy for issuance.

ops: FYI scheduling: spike window reserved 2025-06-02 to implement coordinator prototype. ops will allocate test cluster.

Mei: tests: unit + integration + chaos (worker restarts). add contract tests for idempotency and lease behavior.

Diego: acceptance criteria: 1) parity with old path in shadow mode for 48h 2) no >0.5% divergence in outputs 3) no SLA regression for latency beyond 5% for hot tenants.

Ava: ok. owners: Ava -> coordinator; Mei -> worker/session-store split; Diego -> proto + routing changes. I'll draft a follow-up RFC with diagrams and put it in the rfc repo. :rocket:

core-bot: reminder: please update OWNERS file under infra/orchestration.

Mei: quick opt: can we fold batcher into worker process later to reduce RPCs? keep as future iteration.

Diego: +1. iterate small.

Ava: cool. closing thread; will post RFC link and initial checklist tomorrow.
